body: Comb of TRAPX_NORTHSTAR.md, REDGARDEN-wiki SPEC-4/5, HEROES_VS0.md, RANKED_MATCHMAKING.md, and NORTHSTAR.md itself (via Explore agent) confirmed §29 already existed (2026-08-13) with 4 explicit open architecture questions and zero prior art anywhere in the monorepo for rarity/pack/pity card mechanics. Resolved question 1 (player directly pilots hero+pets+clones; everything else is a card) and question 4 (recommend apps/arena's arena_game.c as the base sim loop, extended, not local_game.c or a new third loop) directly from real-time founder fragments. Added a full net-new card/economy design section. Flagged, not silently resolved: a real Flow-naming collision between REDGARDEN's own kill-fed Flow and TRAPX/SHANKPIT's territory Flow. Questions 2 and 3 remain genuinely open.
title: ECOWAR northstar (§29) addendum — 2 open questions resolved + full card/economy design
